**Construction Management** is a Bachelor of Technology degree-completion program focused on management, technical, and interpersonal skills for construction projects.

- **Credential:** Bachelor of Technology / bachelor’s degree  
- **Format:** Full-time or part-time, in person  
- **Campus:** Burnaby  
- **Curriculum:** Construction controls, organizational management, stakeholder engagement, professional standards, at least 4 credits of approved management electives, and 12 Liberal Studies credits.
- **Course examples:** **CMGT 7190 – Construction Planning and Controls**, **CMGT 7330 – Finance for Construction Managers**, and **CMGT 7535 – Leadership and Interpersonal Skills**.
- **Final project:** After **CMGT 8700 – Industry Based Project Proposal**, students choose either **CMGT 8800 – Industry Based Project** or **CMGT 8810 – Industry Based Project**, subject to department approval for the chosen project course.

[Construction Management program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)
